turn.title: Video call relay (TURN)
turn.subtitle: Helps calls connect on strict networks — each Cloudflare account gives 1 TB/month free
turn.poolSub: Add each account's TURN Token ID + API token here; when one runs out the next takes over automatically, or switch manually
turn.envNote: A key set on Vercel (CF_TURN_KEY_ID + CF_TURN_API_TOKEN) is also used automatically.
turn.empty: No TURN keys in the pool yet.
turn.tokenHint: Same value as the STORAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable on Vercel
